QuestInfo.name: Gaga's New Business
QuestInfo.0: Gaga needs your help with something. Visit him or click on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen to find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: After bringing the Monkey Doll to Gaga once a day, every day, you received a #t04162005# that can be stamped inside. Click the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen for the #rFind My Monkey Dolls!#k quest.
QuestInfo.2: After bringing the Monkey Doll to Gaga once a day, every day, you received a #t04162005# that can be stamped inside. Click the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen for the #rFind My Monkey Dolls!#k quest.
